usage: kathara connect [-h] [-d DIRECTORY | -v] [--shell SHELL] [-l]
                       DEVICE_NAME

Connect to a Kathara device

positional arguments:
  DEVICE_NAME           Name of the device to connect to.

options:
  -h, --help            Show a help message and exit.
  -d, --directory DIRECTORY
                        Specify the folder containing the network scenario.
  -v, --vmachine        The device has been started with vstart command.
  --shell SHELL         Shell that should be used inside the device.
  -l, --logs            Print device startup logs before launching the shell.

For examples and further information visit:
https://github.com/KatharaFramework/Kathara/wiki
